name: GhostTooltipProvider
description: Groups adjacent GhostTooltip instances so pointer moves between triggers can skip the open delay within skipDelayDuration.

props.name: delayDuration
props.description:
Default open delay for descendant {@link GhostTooltip } roots that omit
their own `delayDuration`.

props.name: skipDelayDuration
props.description:
Milliseconds after a descendant tooltip closes during which the next
pointer-driven show may skip the open delay.
